response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing') as powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing')), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM status_counts), status_shares AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.count, CAST(sc.count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(tc.total AS DECIMAL) as share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(ss.count) as total_telescopes, AVG(ss.share) as average_share, AVG(ss.share - ashr.avg_share) as above_average FROM status_shares ss CROSS JOIN average_share ashr WHERE ss.share > ashr.avg_share
